description: This file defines a class 'Oauth2AuthCodesViewAuthorize' which handles OAuth2 authorization requests within a SuiteCRM module. It manages the display of authorization prompts, validates requests, and interacts with OAuth2 server components, including request/session management and rendering Smarty templates.

classes.name: Oauth2AuthCodesViewAuthorize
classes.description: A view class responsible for handling OAuth2 authorization requests in SuiteCRM, rendering authorization UI, and managing OAuth2 request validation and approval.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the authorization request flow: validates the OAuth2 request, associates user info, creates a session record, prepares Smarty template variables, and renders the authorization page or completes the authorization process.
